song.name: Heart of War
song.plot: Eldrin faces the Shadow Balrog — a powerful adversary corrupted by dark forces who guards the ancient door and seeks the Heartstone. A final confrontation ensues that will determine the fate of the world.
song.analysis: The original is a bloated, generic battle anthem with two bridges, five verses and a "we" chorus. The reworked version is trimmed (one verse and one chorus removed) and recast in Eldrin's singular voice. The adversary is the Shadow Balrog, guardian of the ancient door to the Heartstone. Incoherences removed: "Armies clash" (the fight is 1v1 — now "The Balrog roars"), the plural "Heroes rise" (now "I stand alone"), the false "A sacrifice, to save our life" (now "I'll guard the flame, I'll guard the life"), and "we find our way" (now "I find my way"). The outro's "Sacrifice demanded, a heavy toll" intentionally foreshadows The Weight of Eternity — the 400-year vigil Eldrin must pay. Suggested song direction: deep demonic vocals, thundering drums, epic orchestral battle.

section.name: Verse 1
section.original: Darkness gathers, a looming threat, A final stand, a desperate fight. Magic unleashed, a cosmic clash, Sacrifice demanded, a heavy toll.
section.reworked: A shadow rises from the floor, The guardian of the ancient door. It hungers for the light I hold, A story of destruction told.

section.name: Pre-Chorus
section.original: In the shadows, whispers grow, A storm of fate, a deadly show. Heroes rise, with hearts of fire, In the night, their spirits higher.
section.reworked: In the shadows, whispers grow, A storm of fate, a deadly show. I stand alone, with heart of fire, In the night, my spirit higher.

section.name: Chorus
section.original: Heart of War, the battle's cry, In the darkness, we defy. With magic's might, and courage bold, A tale of legends, fierce and old.
section.reworked: Heart of War, the battle's cry, I will not yield, I will not die. With magic's might, and will of steel, I force the shadow entity to kneel.

section.name: Verse 2
section.original: Armies clash, in the midnight hour, A dance of death, a surge of power. Blades and spells, in chaos blend, A fight for life, until the end.
section.reworked: The Balrog roars, the midnight hour, A dance of death, a surge of power. Fangs and flame, in chaos blend, A fight for life, until the end.

section.name: Bridge
section.original:
In the heart of war, a light will shine, A hero's soul, a fate divine. Through the pain, and through the strife, A sacrifice, to save our life.
